title: Sharing of Work Done by Religious Rehabilitation Group
what_it_is: Sharing of Work Done by Religious Rehabilitation Group

sections.label: Counter-extremism training for asatizahs and madrasah students
sections.summary: The CPE includes an RRG counter-extremism module for asatizahs, and RRG engages madrasah students on radicalisation threats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Since 2013, the CPE includes a key module on counter-extremism by the Religious Rehabilitation Group (RRG).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Through this module, the RRG shares with asatizahs its experience in rehabilitating and reintegrating former Jemaah Islamiyah members into society.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Majlis Ugama Islam Singapura (MUIS) and RRG will continue to update this module to ensure its relevance and aim for every asatizahs to attend it.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Currently, 80% of our asatizahs are part of ARS and we will encourage the remaining 20% to come on board.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Many asatizahs have visited the RRG Resource and Counselling Centre (RCC) at Khadijah Mosque since its launch in 2014 to learn first-hand RRG's efforts in tackling extremist ideologies, especially those on social media platforms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The RRG also engages our secondary and post-secondary madrasah students on the threats of radicalisation and extremism through platforms, such as learning journeys to the RCC and the Madrasah Pre-U Seminar.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The Madrasah Pre-University Seminar is attended by all secondary and pre-University madrasah students and is held every two to three years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: MUIS will continue to strengthen the madrasah curriculum with relevant content developed by the RRG.
